title: Server-derived debug flag on a shared DTO: one-handler reset, other-tenant stamp, missed producer, removed overload
spec: Mark every stored transcript row of a debug session with debug_active = true. The flag is derived by the server from the session's debug options; a client must never be able to set it. Normal traffic must be unchanged.
pr_description: Adds debug_active to MessageDto, omitted from JSON while false, so normal payloads are byte-identical. The orchestrator stamps it once per turn from the session context, including the account-mismatch error path. SocketHandler resets any client-supplied value, so the flag is server-derived only. Converter.toRow gains a debugActive argument; the old three-argument toRow keeps working and defaults to false. The error fallback now passes the message's flag to LogContext instead of null.
